summary: Staff claims, private order/customer reads and server-only order/review creation were released on 2026-10-26. Emulator security tests and deployed checkout tests pass. This is a scoped application review, not a guarantee against every security issue.

findings.issue: Authenticated APIs and persistent UID/source request limits are active, but App Check remains optional because its public site key and domains have not been registered.
findings.recommendation: Register the production web app with App Check, configure the public site key and allowed domains, validate genuine browser requests, then enable required token verification.
